_doc: Named evaluation seed sets (board seeds; each seed is played once per seat). Training must never use seeds inside these sets -- training drivers check this. 'inloop' is reused by every in-training eval and is a selection signal only; 'selection' ranks candidates/checkpoints; 'confirm_*' back a claim and each should be used once per claim (usage is logged to seed_usage.jsonl). Ranges in 'reserved' are burned/used elsewhere and must not be reused for evaluation.

inloop.purpose: in-loop selection signal (rl_finetune --eval-seed-bases); never quote as a result

reserved.use: training rollouts / demo collection; legacy in-loop eval bases (800k, 2M, 700k)
legacy confirmatory/in-loop eval bases (burned, see memory)
